nextStoryContext: US-005 added boot-read item + opening-blocker-line paragraph for `.claude/.cam-gate.json` (the generic operator-decision gate from US-003/US-004, src/supervisor/gate.ts's CamGate: gate/options/context/decision) to BOTH templates/agents/subagent-orchestrator.md (numbered item 13, after the sidecar-stalled marker) and .claude/agents/subagent-orchestrator.md (numbered item 12 there -- that live copy was ALREADY missing item 12/sidecar-stalled relative to templates/ before this story; that pre-existing drift is untouched/out-of-scope per surgical-changes, do not silently 'fix' it in a future story without a story that asks for it). Ran `bun run embed-vendor` to regenerate src/vendor/_generated.ts (templates/ is embedded; .claude/agents/*.md is NOT, per scripts/generate-embedded-vendor.ts -- it only walks vendor/ and templates/). `.claude/.cam-gate.json` had to be added to .gitignore (it wasn't yet, even though src/supervisor/gate.ts's GATE_FILENAME + writeGateFile/readGateFile already existed from US-003/US-004): scripts/validate-agents-md.ts's path-claim checker (wired into check:all's agents-md gate) resolves untracked citations against `git check-ignore` and only allowlists via KNOWN_MISSING as a fallback -- a citation that is neither tracked, ignored, nor allowlisted fails the gate (see patterns.md's 'Per-file KNOWN_MISSING allowlisting' and 'git check-ignore exit 128' bullets for the mechanism). Nothing else in the gate-lifecycle plumbing (write/notify/poll/resolve/clear/flip, US-003; in-progress-conflict resolver wiring, US-004) was touched -- this story is pure orchestrator-prompt prose plus the one .gitignore line the prose now implies.
